central_answers.source_support: S3-root-skin-wounds has explicit nominative ἡ ῥίζα after S3-extraction. Masculine juice is then displaced by feminine root/participles.
central_answers.honeylike_juice_clause_kind: physical juice preparation with consistency endpoint; neither clinical effect nor executed efficacy experiment
central_answers.juice_is_effectless: Not established: S2 explicitly assigns several clinical uses to juice. Distinguishing §3 ownership does not deny other juice uses.
central_answers.chemical_exclusion: Grammatical root ownership does not prove unprocessed intact root or chemically exclude preparations derived from root. It blocks automatic ownership carryover from prior juice; stronger pharmaceutical identity needs separate evidence.

section3_connected_rendering: The root is made into juice by being pounded and pressed out, the juice being boiled until it reaches a honeylike consistency. The root also cleanses the skin and suppresses eruptions, and heals wounds with vinegar, on its own, and with honey. Applied as a poultice, it also reduces or melts the spleen; it clears freckles and alopecias and is suitable for sprains and gout. Its decoction is effective for small sores on the head and for chilblains when poured over them; the root itself is also boiled in old oil, with the oil applied as a smear [the same usefulness is supplied elliptically]. This is a connected rendering of the source claims, with the changes of subject retained; it does not turn the whole paragraph into one serial juice recipe.

clause_bearers.reading: Ivy comparison belongs to leaves; rose-like/purplish description to flowers; dark/turnip-like/somewhat flattened description to root. These do not transfer the clinical subject to a comparator plant.

clause_bearers.bearer: root (relative feminine ἥτις, then feminine participles)
clause_bearers.reading: Root drunk with hydromel brings down phlegm and water; drunk or locally applied it moves menses. The source couples material, mode and claimed effect; not an extraction operation.

clause_bearers.bearer: pregnant woman for miscarriage; root for worn material
clause_bearers.reading: The stepping-over claim is marked they say; αὐτήν there is the pregnant woman, not the root. Feminine worn/bound-on material returns to root. Do not assign every αὐτ- pronoun the same owner.
Root drinking with wine against fatal substances/sea-hare, poultice against reptiles, and intoxication when mixed with wine. No juice noun has yet appeared.

clause_bearers.bearer: root implicit in ποθεῖσα; patient; emitted sweat
clause_bearers.statement_kind: clinical assertion plus explicit patient procedure
clause_bearers.reading: Three-drachma root drink with sweet wine/sweet liquid or dilute honey-drink is followed by reclining the drinker in a warm room and wrapping in more garments to sweat; emitted sweat is described as bile-coloured. The root is not described as sweating. γλυκέος leaves its noun unexpressed; no novel liquid identity is bound here.

clause_bearers.bearer: juice explicit masculine ὁ χυλὸς; αὐτῆς source root/plant feminine
clause_bearers.reading: Juice with honey is instilled into nostrils for cleansing the head and applied in wool at the anus for removal of waste. Anus rendering supported by LSJ δακτύλιος II.2; no finger operation is required.

clause_bearers.bearer: juice masculine αὐτοῦ, then explicit ὁ χυλὸς
clause_bearers.reading: Juice smeared on navel/lower abdomen/hip softens the belly and produces the defective-cache term ἐκτρρσμούς; do not silently emend it. Juice smeared with honey suits the stated eye conditions (clouded/dim sight).

Juice is mixed into abortive preparations and smeared with vinegar restores prolapsed rectum/anus. JSON repeats ὁ χυλὸς here, but paired XML tags that phrase del and apparatus says delevi; the subject is supported by continuity, not that deleted phrase.

clause_bearers.bearer: root as extraction input; juice as boiling input
clause_bearers.reading: Root is made into juice by pounding/chopping and squeezing/pressing; juice is boiled until honeylike consistency. No human operator is named. These present/passive process statements specify preparation, not a documented executed experiment. Honeylike consistency is a physical endpoint; no cure or potency endpoint is asserted, and actual honey is not an ingredient in this clause.

clause_bearers.bearer: root explicitly reintroduced ἡ ῥίζα; feminine ἑαυτήν
clause_bearers.statement_kind: clinical claims with alternative preparation adjuncts
clause_bearers.reading: Root cleanses skin, suppresses eruptions, heals wounds with vinegar, by itself, and with honey. The juice noun from the preceding genitive absolute does not become the required grammatical bearer of these claims.

clause_bearers.bearer: root through feminine καταπλασσομένη and continued finite subjects
clause_bearers.reading: Applied as a poultice root reduces/melts the spleen; it clears freckles and alopecias and suits sprains and gout. The masculine juice cannot directly govern the feminine participle. Exact historical disease labels and mechanism are not modern diagnoses.

clause_bearers.bearer: decoction explicit neuter; source root/plant αὐτῆς feminine
clause_bearers.reading: Its decoction is effective for small head sores and chilblains when poured over them. Neuter καταντλούμενον agrees with decoction, not feminine root or masculine juice. αὐτῆς can refer to root or plant as the entry material; it does not agree with masculine χυλός.

clause_bearers.bearer: root itself feminine αὐτή/ἀναζεσθεῖσα; oil explicit applied material
clause_bearers.statement_kind: oil preparation plus elliptical clinical relation
clause_bearers.reading: Root itself is boiled in/with old oil, the oil being smeared on. Clinical suitability is elliptical from the preceding sores/chilblains clause; the immediately applied material is oil. Neither same extracted juice nor same physical batch is asserted. Cache δἰ is retained, not silently corrected.

clause_bearers.bearer: root implicit feminine hollowed/filled; oil fill; optional wax; resulting smear
clause_bearers.reading: Hollowed root is filled with oil and put on hot ashes. Sometimes a little Tyrrhenian wax is added so the product becomes sticky; described as an excellent smear for chilblains. ὡς γλοιῶδες has an unexpressed neuter result/product subject, not an explicit assertion that root or extracted juice becomes sticky. Wax is optional, not mandatory; this is not established as a subsequent stage of boiling extracted juice.

clause_bearers.bearer: root explicitly stored and femininely burned/formed; plant in habitat
clause_bearers.statement_kind: storage instruction; reported love-potion use; habitat
clause_bearers.reading: Cut root is put away as squill is; it is reported used in love-potions after burning and forming into pastilles. Habitat belongs to the plant growing in shady places, especially under trees. No clinical confirmation follows from reported magical use.

whole_entry_roles: Section 1 joins organ description with several root uses and one reported stepping-over belief. Section 2 continues a root drink, embeds a patient warming/sweating procedure, then changes explicitly to juice applications. Section 3 explains extraction/thickening, reintroduces root effects, and changes to decoction/oil contexts. Section 4 gives a hollow-root/oil/optional-wax preparation, root storage, reported love-potion manufacture and habitat. The four numbered editorial sections are not four exclusive semantic roles or a mandatory four-stage program.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: A proposed faithful interpretation keeps juice as the compulsory grammatical bearer of the skin/rash/wound sequence immediately after extraction.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: Explicit root reintroduction and feminine agreement in S3-root-skin-wounds / S3-root-continued.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: Boiling to honeylike consistency is treated as the claimed cure, clinical endpoint, potency level or mandatory honey addition.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: Preparation endpoint in S3-extraction; honey admixture appears in separate usage clauses and is lexically distinct.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: Juice, decoction and applied oil are merged as one named substance solely because all are produced from root.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: Distinct explicit nouns and grammatical agreement in S2-juice-uses / S3-decoction / S3-old-oil.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: Every outcome is attributed to material alone while stated administration conditions, mixture alternatives or patient actions are discarded.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: Root drinking, warm-room/wrapping/sweating, juice application sites, poultice, decoction irrigation and oil smear materially constrain the clauses.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: The whole entry is forced into exactly four exclusive roles or one unavoidable serial recipe from root to juice to decoction to oil.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: Each section contains mixed relations, root is repeatedly reintroduced, and no such fixed role scheme or batch continuity is asserted.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: Present/passive preparation language is reported as evidence that an efficacy experiment was actually executed and passed.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: The source gives processes and asserted/conditional uses, without a dated execution, measurements of efficacy or observed trial result.

falsifiable_constraints.reject_if: Optional wax becomes mandatory, or reported stepping-over/love-potion claims become confirmed clinical observations.
falsifiable_constraints.reason: ἐνίοτε marks sometimes; φασί / ἱστορεῖται mark reported statements.

uncertainties: Root versus plant antecedent for some feminine αὐτῆς/αὐτή is not always lexically repeated; local root continuity is strong, masculine juice is not a direct agreeing antecedent.
S3-old-oil lacks a fresh finite efficacy predicate. Carrying preceding head-sores/chilblains usefulness into it is a contextual ellipsis, not a separately explicit efficacy assertion.
No same physical batch is specified between extracted juice, decoction, old-oil treatment and hollow-root recipe; procedure alternatives/relationships cannot be over-fixed.
Cache defects ἐκτρρσμούς, δἰ, ἀναπλασθεἰσάν and section numerals remain uncorrected. Exact English for the defective §2 term is not bound.
γλυκέος omits a noun in main text; sweet wine is conventional but liquid identity is not needed for bearer result.
JSON main text retains ὁ χυλὸς where XML has del and apparatus says delevi. This prevents treating every JSON word as unqualified critical accepted text.
No assessment of scientific novelty against predecessors and no target/model consequence was possible under source-only blinding; source constraints alone establish no Voynich meaning.
